verdict.rationale: 1Password ships its own programmatic surfaces for vault access. The op CLI integrates with the local desktop app and can list vault items, Connect Servers expose items via a private REST API, and the SDKs read secrets programmatically. An agent can therefore query secrets without screen-scraping. However, the evidence does not show agent retrieval of one-time codes, Connect is aimed at company infrastructure rather than a local desktop endpoint, and the official Environments MCP server explicitly does not return secrets to the agent. missing for 10: documented agent retrieval of TOTP/one-time codes via a programmatic surface, a local agent-facing endpoint (e.g. MCP) that actually returns vault secrets, independent or hands-on corroboration of agent use.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can expose the vault through a local programmatic endpoint an agent can query for codes and secrets without screen-scraping the app
